title: PDF Poster Splitter — Split Vector PDFs to A4 & Letter
description: Split large A0, A1, or architectural PDFs across multiple A4 or Letter pages without losing vector sharpness. Free, private, no watermarks.
lead: Tile oversized A0, A1, and multi-page PDFs onto A4 or US Letter sheets while keeping vector lines, CAD text, and curves razor-sharp.

sections.heading: Why Vector PDF Clipping Matters for Blueprints & Charts
paragraphs: Most online PDF poster splitters convert your PDF into a low-resolution PNG first, turning crisp technical lines, floor plans, and small labels into fuzzy jagged pixels — and inflating a 500 KB drawing into a 40 MB download.

WidePosterMaker embeds your original PDF page once as a single PDF Form XObject and applies exact PDF clipping rectangles per sheet. Fonts, Bezier curves, and CAD vectors stay mathematically sharp at any enlargement.
list: Multi-page PDF page picker: choose the exact sheet you want to enlarge.
Honors source PDF CropBox and /Rotate (0°, 90°, 180°, 270°) automatically.
True Scale (100%) mode reads the PDF's real physical point dimensions for 1:1 architectural or pattern output.
Automatic high-DPI raster fallback if an encrypted or non-standard PDF prevents direct XObject embedding.

sections.heading: Best Settings for Splitting Large PDFs
paragraphs: If you want exact 1:1 physical dimensions from an A0 or A1 PDF, switch Size By to True Scale (%) and enter 100. Keep Printer Margin at 5 mm (or your printer's minimum border) and Glue Overlap at 10 mm so seams never drift across rows.

faqs.q: Does splitting a PDF keep text and linework as vectors?
faqs.a: Yes. Standard unencrypted PDFs are split using native PDF Form XObject clipping, so all paths and embedded fonts remain true vectors.

faqs.q: What if my PDF has multiple pages?
faqs.a: Once loaded, Prev and Next page buttons appear right above the preview so you can select and tile the exact page you need.

faqs.q: Why does my tiled PDF print slightly smaller than expected?
faqs.a: In your PDF viewer's print dialog, turn off 'Fit to page' or 'Shrink oversized pages' and choose 'Actual Size' or '100% Scale'. You can double-check with the 50 mm / 2 in ruler on Page 1.

faqs.q: Does it work with password-protected PDFs?
faqs.a: Unencrypted PDFs work directly in vector mode. If a PDF restricts modification, WidePosterMaker automatically falls back to high-resolution local rendering when readable.
